tools.name: brightai_overview
tools.title: BrightAI overview
tools.description: Who BrightAI is, what the Stateful platform does, canonical platform-scale figures, and the live worldwide opportunity numbers from BrightAI's Global Observability Database (BGOD). Includes press-facts and investor-thesis sections. Start here.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.title: Industry list
tools.description: Every essential-services vertical BrightAI has mapped, each with live anonymized aggregates: addressable annual impact (USD/yr), operators profiled, and observability problem-family count. The count is whatever the live catalog holds — read it from the response rather than assuming a fixed number. Use get_industry for depth on one vertical.

tools.name: get_industry
tools.title: Industry deep-dive
tools.description: One vertical in depth: live aggregates plus its top observability problem families (names, first-sentence definitions, applicability). Accepts the slug from list_industries (e.g. "oil-and-gas") or a close industry name.

industry.description: Slug or name of the vertical, e.g. "water-and-wastewater" or "Oil & Gas".

tools.name: list_problem_families
tools.title: Observability problem catalog
tools.description: The canonical catalog of observability problem families BrightAI has mapped worldwide (the public taxonomy). Optionally filter by industry slug or a name substring.

search.description: Optional substring filter on family name.

limit.description: Max rows, default 40 (compact). Ask for more or filter by industry/search when needed.

tools.name: get_problem_family
tools.title: Problem deep-dive
tools.description: The complete public definition of one observability problem family: formal definition, anatomy (manifestations / measurement / intervention), typical assets, and which verticals it applies to.

tools.name: check_company
tools.title: Company lookup
tools.description: Name (or website domain) lookup against BrightAI's Global Observability Database. Returns neutral public facts only: whether the company is profiled, its industry, HQ, a one-line description, and the NAMES and COUNT of observability problem families identified for it. Minor spelling variations are matched automatically — a matched_via: "close_spelling" flag marks a did-you-mean correction; confirm the corrected name with the user. Deeper detail (including any modeled figures) is available only to verified employees of the company itself - rolling out shortly. Not a search tool: pass the company's actual name or domain.

name.description: Company name, e.g. "Osmose Utilities Services". Close spellings are okay.
